page.content:
First AEW World Champion and Inner Circle leader.

How Chris Jericho connects

  • Item: AEW World Championship — Chris Jericho was the first AEW World Champion.
  • Faction: The Inner Circle — Jericho led the Inner Circle.

What is Chris Jericho?

Chris Jericho was AEW's first world champion, founded the Inner Circle, and later the Jericho Appreciation Society, anchoring the company's earliest TV feuds.

Key threads lead to AEW World Championship and The Inner Circle.
